title: Your Code Is Being Rewritten While It Runs
description:
The same loop, a thousand times — and the last run is ten times faster than the first. That's not caching. That's the JVM watching your code and rewriting it on the fly.

HotSpot finds your hottest loops, throws out the slow paths, and emits machine code tuned to the exact hardware you're running on. It only works while the program is actually working.

Full breakdown of how the JVM really executes your code on the channel.

#Shorts #Java #JVM #JIT #programming
